Honestly, I just got back from the Holiday Inn by IHG and I'm torn about my recent stay. The staff were super friendly and helpful, unlike the Hyatt where I felt rushed during check-in. On the other hand, the location is a bit of a pain since it's stuck way off the main road compared to where I stayed last time. While the Marriott offered a disappointing breakfast, the food at the Holiday Inn was actually pretty good with some tasty hot options. All in all, the minor issues with the parking really didn't ruin the trip too much for me.

ok so the room was pretty comfy and clean when i walked in, though the furniture felt a bit dated. the lobby area just looked kinda messy and the decor was totally bland to be honest. but honestly the bed was super soft for the price and the layout was actually pretty cool. i grabbed breakfast this morning and the eggs were actually really good. the gym fees were way too high but at least the pool was open late which was nice.
Just stayed here a few days ago. The beds were super comfy but the service was hit or miss. The pool area felt a bit messy.
It was better than expected, though the room could use some cleaning fixes. The location is just fine for getting around the city.

stayed at a holiday inn near the city center a few days ago and the rooms were surprisingly spacious with clean, modern finishes. the staff at check-in were super friendly and helped me get settled in no time flat. the room had standard wifi which was okay, but the bed was incredibly plush and comfortable for sleeping. however, the overall hotel vibe felt a bit dated and the hallway lighting made the place feel gloomy and uncomfortable. the pillow selection was just average but the room's design features like the large windows and color scheme were actually quite nice.

I was really excited to stay here after my last trip, but it felt a bit off from the start. Unlike the Hyatt I visited last month, the food options here were pretty limited and the breakfast prices were just way too high for what you get. Honestly, I kept wondering if I should have just stayed at the Marriott after all, especially since the rooms were okay but nothing special. On the other hand, the staff at the front desk were super friendly and helped me out right away when I had trouble with my key card.

Honestly the service was a bit hit or miss and felt like there were some occasional inconsistencies during my stay a few days ago. But the room amenities were surprisingly nice though, with a super comfy bed and a great coffee maker right in the room. The location was perfect since it was right downtown and close to all the places I needed to visit. Anyway the rooms were a steal for the price and felt super comfortable with a modern design that really made the space feel welcoming.

Just checked in last night after a long drive. The lobby was SPARKLING clean and the rates were great, but the gym equipment felt old. Honestly expected a bit more given the brand name though. The room layout was just SO confusing to navigate.
stayed here after a pricey stay at the marriott and while the new modern decor is actually cool, the carpets were gross, but the gym setup was way better than expected.

The breakfast spread had a weird selection of options, but the prices were surprisingly reasonable and the coffee was actually quite good. I was traveling with my spouse for a quick work trip. The location was a real hassle since it was tucked away in a noisy area with no nearby shops. The rooms looked fine with standard decor and the rates matched the local market perfectly. The check-in process was frustrating because the front desk agent seemed distracted and forgot to mention the Wi-Fi password.

Ok so the stay was solid overall even if the rooms felt a bit standard. Location is perfect for hitting downtown spots right away. Prices are great plus decor looks modern but service could be better in some areas.

after a long drive, we just pulled up to this spot last night and decided to check in. the rates were surprisingly affordable for what you get, and the lobby facilities felt modern without breaking the bank. additionally, the location is perfect for accessing nearby attractions without any hassle or long commutes. furthermore, the room amenities were spotless and the bed comfort was incredibly cozy after a tiring day.

reviews.text: The room for improvement was needed but the prices were great. So I just arrived a few days ago. And the staff were super helpful. The bed was okay but the decor looked nice.

Wow, the bed and TV in the room were actually really comfortable and nice! I just checked in a few days ago after a long drive. The pool area could be better in some areas but the fitness center was great. Honestly, the vibe of the place was just what I needed after work. Everyone at the front desk was super friendly and helpful throughout my stay.

location was just perfect near the highway. facilities are okay. prices were fair. gym is small. rooms looked modern. bed was super comfy. bathroom was clean enough. service was kinda slow though. room for improvement.
just stayed there a few days ago and the room was super clean honestly.

Unlike last time at that other chain, this room was a bit rough around the edges with mismatched decor, but the bed quality was surprisingly great.  On the other hand, the staff were just so friendly and helpful during my stay a few days ago.

I stopped by the Holiday Inn for a quick overnight trip and the breakfast prices seemed pretty average compared to other chains. The check-in process was okay, nothing particularly special happened when I arrived. However, the staff member at the front desk was incredibly helpful and went out of their way to ensure I got a quiet room. The room felt spacious and the bed was comfortable, although I did notice some crumbs left on the nightstand. It was definitely a comfortable stay overall, but the carpet in the hallway smelled musty and the air conditioning unit was making a weird noise. The coffee station was well stocked with fresh beans, the eggs were cooked perfectly, but there were only a couple of pastry choices available. The juice selection was a bit limited though, yet the fruit was fresh and the waffles tasted great for the price. Unfortunately, I had to wait quite a while for the housekeeping team to arrive and fix the issues in my room. Since I was traveling with a small child, the lack of immediate attention to the bathroom cleanliness was a bit stressful. At least the morning oatmeal was hot and creamy, which helped start the day on a better note. The fitness center was well-equipped with modern machines, which was a nice surprise to find. The pool water was clean and the lounge chairs were sturdy, but the poolside bar prices are a bit steep and the hours are limited.
just checked in last night but the room was kinda dusty and the sheets felt sticky.

Unlike my last stay at a competing chain where the bed was stiff and the tv barely worked, the room here was actually comfy with great amenities and just felt really nice overall. Plus, the location was super convenient for everything we needed to do.

food prices were kinda high for a quick bite random stuff in the lobby felt a bit generic design was nice though rooms were just clean enough stayed here just last week actually breakfast eggs were actually pretty good

Just stayed here a couple days ago and the location is honestly perfect for everything we needed. We were driving through on a road trip and needed a solid place to crash without any hassle. After checking in quickly with the staff who were super friendly, we headed straight up to our room. The modern design features throughout the lobby and hallways really gave the whole place a fresh, clean vibe.

For anyone considering a stay here, the service was just okay and nothing really stood out. I stopped by a few days ago and happened to catch the front desk crew during their quiet afternoon shift. But honestly the staff was super friendly and really made sure everything was perfect.

The pool area was a bit underwhelming and could be better in some areas, but the rooms were generally clean enough for a quick stay. Just picked up a rate deal last weekend, and while the check-in was smooth, the minor issues with the gym equipment left a bit to be desired.

Mixed feelings on this stay. The bed was comfy but the room looked tired. Fresh linens helped though. Facilities were lacking. Nothing special here. Room was spotless. Nice modern touch. Just right for a quick trip.

Just stopped by the Holiday Inn by IHG near the highway last week and honestly, the location is unbeatable for a quick getaway. The room was super clean with a comfy bed, modern design, and honestly way cheaper than what I've been paying at other chains lately. It was so comfortable and well-designed that I barely noticed the time, plus the whole place just felt right from the moment I walked in. They had some great breakfast choices but the coffee was just okay, nothing special really. The pool area is nice and modern but the prices for using the fitness center were a bit steep compared to what you usually get elsewhere.

Just pulled in last week and the LOCATION is absolutely perfect for everything. Staff went ABOVE AND BEYOND to fix a mix-up but the prices are just too high. The bed was SO comfy though, slept like a baby.

So I just checked in a couple days ago after a long drive. Honestly the room prices felt a bit steep for what you get especially with some minor issues around the place. I mean I was pretty tired so I didn't mind too much at first. The staff were super friendly and helped me out right away. They really made the whole experience great with their general service.

Heads up though, the breakfast prices are a bit steep AND the food quality was kinda disappointing, but at least the style options were GREAT. However, the cleanliness in the rooms was just fine and the general facilities were SUPER nice.
The bed was actually super comfy and the modern decor looked great, but the room overall could be better in some areas.

room was clean enough and price was decent. decor was just okay honestly. beds comfy. wifi fast. everything worked well. location perfect near highway. pool needs work. room noise okay. breakfast good. lots of choices. coffee strong.

i was about to leave early 'cause the front desk was totally ignoring me when i walked up. but the staff actually ran over and got me sorted out instantly, which was super nice. the room was fine but the pool area felt a little outdated honestly.

Heads up if you are tired of overpriced, cramped stays like my last visit to a certain Marriott where I paid double for less space. The room amenities here are decent for the price I paid, though the bathroom layout could use some improvement. On the other hand, the pool area and fitness center are great value for guests who want to stay active without extra fees. It is honestly refreshing to finally find a spot that doesn't feel like a money trap compared to my recent frustrations.

so i checked in a few days ago and the lobby looked standard enough, nothing too flashy or outdated. then i found the room to be pretty cramped and the shower pressure was just terrible. overall the hotel felt like a decent spot though, the staff were super friendly even if there were occasional inconsistencies with housekeeping. the decor in the hallways was just okay, nothing special but not terrible either.

Ok so I just dropped in at the Holiday Inn by IHG last week for a quick family trip. Check in was super smooth and they even had my room ready a bit early which was nice. Man the lobby area felt pretty clean and the staff were actually friendly. The breakfast buffet had a good variety of options to choose from. The beds were comfy and the room felt great especially considering the price we paid.
so i stayed here just a few days after trying a nearby chain and honestly the check-in was way smoother. the staff was super friendly and really went out of their way to make the stay comfortable.
the room was clean and had free wifi. stayed here last night.
The team went above and beyond to make our stay feel special.

reviews.text: Honestly, the room itself felt just average for what I paid, especially since the nightly rate felt a bit steep for that quality. While the public spaces were spotless and I noticed the cleanliness was top-notch, the facility fees seemed excessive given the general offerings. On the bright side, the sleeping accommodations were surprisingly affordable compared to other chains, yet the overall vibe was lacking. As for the neighborhood, it was situated in a location that was neither particularly convenient nor inconvenient for my needs. The equipment provided in the lounge was in excellent working order and felt quite high quality. Furthermore, the proximity to the main road made getting around the city much easier than I expected. Although the amenities were just standard, the overall facility experience was quite pleasant for a quick getaway. The in-room items were disappointing in quality, but the cost was reasonable and the bed comfort was acceptable. I liked the modern design touches and the layout was functional, though the construction quality was merely average. The service throughout the stay was a mixed bag, neither standing out nor causing any major issues. Overall, the hotel was a solid choice with some really nice architectural details that made it feel welcoming. Finally, I must mention that the entire property remained immaculate from the lobby to the hallways.
